Learn more Artemis Program Embroidered PatchSpaceflight Now Shop$10.00 ViewNASA Worm Embroidered Patch ( Gold on Black)Spaceflight Now Shop$8.00 ViewNASA Vector Embroidered PatchSpaceflight Now Shop$10.00 View Description Live: Artemis 2 astronauts return to Earth with a splashdown in the Pacific after Moon mission Watch live coverage as the four astronauts of NASA's Artemis 2 mission return to Earth aboard the Orion capsule 'Integrity'. After a fiery plunge through the atmosphere, the four astronauts will descend under parachutes to a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean, off the coast of San Diego, California. Splashdown is scheduled to occur at 5:07 p.m. PDT (8:07 p.m. EDT / 00:07 UTC). NASA astronaut and mission commander Reid Wiseman leads the crew, which includes fellow NASA astronauts Victor Glover and Christina Koch along with Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen. Join us for live coverage with commentary from Spaceflight Now's Will Robinson-Smith at 2 p.m. PDT (5 p.m. EDT / 2100 UTC). Videos like this are made possible by the support of our members.
